# PredictLeads

PredictLeads provides company intelligence on hiring, technologies, financing, news, products, business connections, and other growth signals.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/predict-leads/.

## Actions

- **Discover Companies** (read-only): Find companies using firmographic filters.
- **Discover Intelligence** (read-only): Discover one page of jobs, technology adoption, news, financing, investor portfolio connections, products, or startup-platform posts…
- **Get API Subscription** (read-only): Check PredictLeads subscription status, monthly credit quota, and credits used.
- **Get Company** (read-only): Retrieve one company by PredictLeads UUID or bare domain.
- **Get Company Intelligence** (read-only): Retrieve one page of a company's jobs, technology detections, news, financing, SEC filings, connections, website changes, GitHub…
- **Get Intelligence Record** (read-only): Retrieve one job opening, extended technology detection, technology, news event, SEC filing, or product by identifier.
- **Get Similar Companies** (read-only): Find one page of companies similar to a specified PredictLeads company UUID or domain.
- **List Followed Companies** (read-only): List one page of companies already followed for PredictLeads webhook updates.
- **Search Technologies** (read-only): Search PredictLeads' tracked technology catalog by fuzzy name.
